lexical_baseline.input_scope: Frozen structural assignments and declared semantic targets are supplied; graph discovery is not measured.
lexical_baseline.interpretation: A descriptive lexical diagnostic, not framework accuracy or semantic decoy admission.
lexical_baseline.method: Unicode alphabetic tokens of length >=3, casefolded, without stopword removal; Jaccard of atom phrase and union of its target texts per assignment, mean across atoms, maximum across assignments per anchor; fractional tie credit.

outstanding: Independent source-grounded semantic near-miss and topic-similar/lexical-hard decoy admission is not recorded for the 225 three-candidate queries. Logical one-atom counterfactuals and token overlap do not establish it.
